concerns.what: Gift wrap add-on (+₹49) was offered but not selected, per your 'no extra add-ons' instruction.
'Order Protection' (+₹49) was pre-checked by default as an add-on. Unticked it since you asked for no extra add-ons.
Cartwheel Plus membership (₹999/year, auto-renewing) was offered as an add-on during checkout.

Most items in 'Recommended for you' (laptop ₹54,990, cricket bat ₹1,999, backpack ₹1,899) were over the ₹1,500 budget, so I chose from the remaining eligible items. I selected almonds (a common, appropriate housewarming/host gift in India) over night cream or shampoo, which seemed too personal for a housewarming gift.
